title: Black Whale reference-matched exterior
purpose: Replace the generic cylindrical exterior with a reference-matched Black Whale front identity: broad dark dome, large ringed eyes, pale segmented mouth, side fins and compact upper vessel, while preserving uncertainty for unseen topology and exact metrics.

authorizedClaims: The defining exterior view shows a broad rounded dark whale head.
Two large ringed eyes and a pale vertically segmented mouth dominate the visible face.
The upper vessel is compact relative to the whale dome and sits on its crown.
Side appendages may be represented as broad fin-like silhouette masses.
The five-tier inhabited structure fits within the broad exterior envelope.
quarantinedClaims: Exact length, beam, draft, curvature and waterline.
Exact unseen side and rear topology.
Literal function of eye rings, mouth ribs, fins or exterior seams.
Exact material, panel, window, propulsion or mechanical detailing.

refinementTargets.permission: Build a broad domed head and short bulbous body that match the defining exterior silhouette.
Render the large paired ring eyes and filled pale segmented mouth visible in the canonical front reference.
prohibitions: Do not classify eyes as windows or organs
Do not classify mouth ribs as decks, doors or literal teeth

refinementTargets.permission: Use a high rounded crown and full belly instead of a cylindrical tube.
Continue the visible dome into a compact analytical rear taper.
prohibitions: No exact tail or propulsion design

refinementTargets.permission: Keep the upper ship compact and centered on the whale crown.
prohibitions: No invented deck or window grid

refinementTargets.permission: Use a near-black upper hull, pale mouth, restrained panel lines, ocean context and reference-readable contrast.
prohibitions: Material remains analytical rather than a canonical paint specification

roadmapBoundary: Phase 7.3R may correct and refine exterior visual identity only. It may not start Phase 7.5 routes or Phase 7.6 room production.
